item.title: Ask HN: What LLM subscription/provider to use with pi harness?
item.summary: I used to use Claude code but obviously they gone downhill for the last 2 to 3 months. I switched to Codex and have been happy with it. Curious what other provider who provides good models at decent pricing? Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49322689 Points: 2 # Comments: 1
